tries.prompt:
A prop sheet for a cut-paper animated film, drawn in the exact house look of the reference images: flat cut-paper shapes with clean simple silhouettes. Each object has ONE warm dark-brown outline around its silhouette, as thick as the outline of the baby's bottle the man holds in reference 1. Very few inner lines. Flat colour fills. Shade with colour only: each shade is the base colour turned toward a cooler or redder hue (cream shades to rose-lavender, terracotta to deep red-brown, wood to dark red-brown, white to pale lavender-blue). Never grey and never black shading. A thin lighter edge on the lit side. Light from the upper left. No gradients, no texture noise, no cast shadows on the ground. No text, no labels, no letters or numbers anywhere. No people, no hands, no table. Plain flat light background. Landscape sheet.

Scale: draw every prop at the scale of the man in reference 1, as if he could pick it up. The baby's bottle is the same size as in his hand in reference 1: about 95 px wide and about 240 px tall on this 1536 x 1024 sheet, with a dark outline about 11 px thick. Every other prop uses the same scale and the same outline thickness.

Lay out eight props in two rows, with clear empty space around each one. No prop touches or overlaps another.

Top row, left to right:
1. The scroll, rolled shut: cream paper wound around its two brown wooden rollers, side by side, with darker turned knob ends (as the scroll in reference 3), held shut by one round gold wax seal.
2. The same scroll open: the cream paper unrolled flat between its two wooden rollers, as in reference 3, with the round gold seal on the paper. The paper is completely blank: no writing, no marks.
3. The baby's bottle, exactly as the man holds it in reference 1, but standing upright alone with no hand: a cream rounded body (#fdf0d6, shaded #d5b09c on its left side), a thin darker collar line under the neck, a rounded orange-amber teat on top (#fcb65d, shaded #e68d39), and a flat rounded base.

Bottom row, left to right:
4. A book lying open, its two cream pages curving up from the spine, a warm brown leather cover showing at the edges.
5. The same book closed, in a slight three-quarter view, with a plain brown leather cover and no title.
6. A long white ribbon flowing in a loose S-curve, as if it pours down: soft white (#fdf8ef) with pale lavender-blue (#d8d4ea) on the inner side of each turn.
7. An ink dropper: a slim pale-blue glass tube with a round dark red-brown rubber bulb on top, dark indigo ink (#2b2440) inside the tube, and one dark ink drop at its tip.
8. Two small terracotta clay cups like the clay cup in reference 4 (#bb5425, lit #e67837, shade #7d3517): one empty, its dark inside showing; one filled with white milk (#fde9c8, shade #e6d0c4) to just under the rim.

Colours: wood for the rollers #8a5233, shade #5f4535. Gold seal #e2a73c, shade #b8692a. The props' outline is a warm dark brown, a little lighter than the figure's outline in reference 1.
